say: In Aero, you control the cursor as well as the runner.
Drag a box around yourself, choose copy, and click to paste, and now there are two of you.
Every copy moves when you move, and jumps when you jump.
You can also cut the whole crew, carry them as faint outlines, and drop them somewhere else.
Aero. You can play it at M P T S dot I E, slash games, slash Aero.
